name: College Romance: Rise of the Little Brother
source:
You are just starting your first year at the university where your brother recently graduated. It's your first exposure to college life, your first time living on your own, and possibly your first true romance.

[From [url=http://www.tycoongames.eu/adventures/collegeromance.php]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚进入哥哥毕业不久的大学，开始大一生活。这是你第一次接触大学生活，第一次独自居住，也可能是第一次真正恋爱。

[摘自[url=http://www.tycoongames.eu/adventures/collegeromance.php]官方网站[/url]]
